source: Full audit of resources/[tarboro]/* on disk, diffed against server.cfg's ensure list, cross-checked against build memory. Re-run this diff any time a resource is added or removed to catch drift immediately.
caveat: Every resource below, including ones marked "good", has never been run by a real connected player. "good" means the build has a real narrative record and passed a boot test (all 60 running resources start cleanly with zero errors) — not that anyone has clicked the prompt, opened the menu, or walked the flow in-game. Status values: crit = not running at all, warn = thin or zero documentation, good = documented.

items.name: tarboro-injuries
items.desc: Bleeding / broken limb / concussion / sickness. Extends tarboro-death, does not replace it.
items.note: Fully implemented on disk. Missing from server.cfg entirely — never boots. The admin /injury:inflict, /injury:cure, /injury:clear commands in tarboro-admin are non-functional orphans until this is added.

items.name: tarboro-interact
items.desc: Shared proximity-interaction UI — the right-side prompt panel with arrow-key navigation used by nearly every other resource.
items.note: No dedicated build record — only known by how constantly it's relied on.

items.name: tarboro-config
items.desc: Shared config table and admin toggles — the single source of truth for every tunable value in the project.

items.name: tarboro-inventory
items.desc: Typed-slot layer on top of ox_inventory — the F2 panel (primary ×2, sidearm, melee, tool ×2, bag expansion).

items.name: tarboro-banking
items.desc: Card-first money: cash / bank / dirty, medical liens, garnishment, society funds, ATM network.

items.name: tarboro-hud
items.desc: The on-screen HUD.
items.note: Only known as an integration point (setVisible export called by other resources) — no dedicated build record.

items.name: tarboro-loading
items.desc: Custom branded loading screen.

items.name: tarboro-character
items.desc: Character creation, appearance, spawn locations, ID/driver/firearm/business licensing, new-player protection.

items.name: tarboro-arrival
items.desc: 8-beat cinematic new-player intake: black screen, establishing shot, voice narration, camera finds player, walk to an intake objective, an admin interview window (Discord webhook + self-release timeout), release into the world.
items.note: Genuinely substantial and previously undocumented. Admin commands exist to skip/release/reset it for testing.

items.name: tarboro-tutorial
items.desc: Soft, fully-skippable "Guided Start" tracker: earn cash → bank it → install an app. Metadata-driven, no DB table.
items.note: Previously undocumented; hooks into banking, phone, and tarboro-arrival's completion event.

items.name: tarboro-death
items.desc: Death / downed state, EMS response, hospital respawn.
items.note: Only known via its NPCRevive export integration — no dedicated build record of the resource itself.

items.name: tarboro-needs
items.desc: Hunger and thirst depletion with consumable items to restore them.

items.name: tarboro-property
items.desc: Real estate: browse/buy/rent, house interiors (16 of 31 assigned), player-named signs, vacant land + object placement, commercial storefronts.

items.name: tarboro-garage
items.desc: Take-out/store at 9 public garages, plus physical driveway vehicle slots on owned properties — parked cars are real, stealable, persistent entities.

items.name: tarboro-fuel
items.desc: Fuel consumption and vehicle wear over time, refuel at pumps.

items.name: tarboro-seatbelt
items.desc: Seatbelt toggle plus a harness item for ejection resistance.

items.name: tarboro-mechanic
items.desc: Mechanic job: diagnose, repair, customize, and bill a customer's vehicle.

items.name: tarboro-gathering
items.desc: World gathering nodes: mining, lumberjacking, stripping scrap cars — 48 nodes, admin-movable/deletable.

items.name: tarboro-fabrication
items.desc: Welding minigame (9 variants across 3 tiers, 12 recipes), vehicle fabrication, 3-tier crafting mastery, Welder's Hood safety-gear requirement.

items.name: tarboro-industry
items.desc: Industrial production lines — smelter, lumber mill, stamping press, machine shop — tick autonomously once loaded with inputs.

items.name: tarboro-drugs
items.desc: 5-tier legal weed economy (cash payout), acid (replaces meth), coke, and crack verticals; baggie-gated packaging.

items.name: tarboro-laundering
items.desc: Converts dirty money to clean at a loss, four NPC laundromat locations.

items.name: tarboro-stocks
items.desc: Player-facing stock market — 8 tickers, insider tips, portfolio tracking.

items.name: tarboro-business
items.desc: Player-owned legal orgs: payroll, shared funds, LinkedUp job postings — plus commercial-property business types (9, including a Mining depot) and a nested illegal/front picker.

items.name: tarboro-shops
items.desc: Player-facing storefronts — Electronics, 24/7 (migrated off ox_inventory's native shop module), YouTool Hardware, Salvage Dealer.

items.name: tl_plants
items.desc: Custom weed and coca 3D plant/bud props, replacing placeholder GTA assets.
items.note: The rare exception actually confirmed working in-game — owner screenshots showed full plants and correct harvest behavior.

items.name: tarboro-crime
items.desc: Cuffing, arrest, jail sentences, illegal-item confiscation on arrest.

items.name: tarboro-theft
items.desc: Permanent vehicle theft (real ownership transfer), security cameras, 4-tier insurance — extended this session to cover physically-parked garage vehicles.

items.name: tarboro-hacking
items.desc: Tiered hacking skill pillar — ATM skims, vehicle camera disables, player theater hacks, and the Vault (a bespoke NUI codebreaker minigame).
items.note: The Vault's real-CEF behavior is repeatedly flagged as the single highest-risk untested piece in the whole project.

items.name: tarboro-prison
items.desc: Daily inmate schedule, prison jobs, contraband, dual-layer (player + NPC) guards.
items.note: Built solo while the owner was unavailable — extra care was taken and explicitly noted at the time.

items.name: tarboro-npcfallback
items.desc: Spawns NPC police/EMS when too few players are on duty, plus ambient population density tuning.

items.name: tarboro-phone
items.desc: The phone itself and most of its app suite — Bank, Messages, Radio/Music, Bills, Real Estate, Garage, Biz Manager, LinkedUp, Darkweb, Insurance, Services, personalizable home screen.
items.note: The one system with the deepest verification on this list — its icon-editing drag interactions were validated in a real disposable browser test harness, though it's still never run inside the actual game client.

items.name: tarboro-allies
items.desc: Mutual accept/reject ally requests, lightweight crews, bail, lien payoff, ally revive, garage vehicle access.

items.name: tarboro-gangs
items.desc: Player-registered gangs with a fixed 4-grade ladder, gang funds, 7-zone turf claiming (Downtown locked to the government).

items.name: tarboro-racing
items.desc: Ad-hoc street challenges, pink-slip wagers with double lock-in confirmation, car meets, organized circuit racing.

items.name: tarboro-heists
items.desc: 3-tier heists (small/medium/marquee) — a shared gear-up safehouse, real-cop-or-NPC-fallback response, one attempt per gear-up.

items.name: tarboro-midgame
items.desc: Progression nudges (property/fabrication/stocks) and an open-world delivery-crate event.

items.name: tarboro-darkweb
items.desc: Anonymous gig/bounty board with escrowed cash.

items.name: tarboro-socialmedia
items.desc: Clout-to-income social feed — profiles, posts, follower thresholds, a sponsor-economy payout.

items.name: tarboro-news
items.desc: Tarboro Tribune — player-authored news articles, phone-only, admin moderation.

items.name: tarboro-requests
items.desc: Player request board — clothing, vehicle liveries, vehicle upgrades, admin-fulfilled.
items.note: Only a one-line cross-reference exists in memory, no dedicated build record.

items.name: tarboro-radio
items.desc: Installable vehicle radio item, GTA native station tuning (music playback itself now lives in the Phone's Music app).

items.name: tarboro-clothing
items.desc: Clothing store interactions.
items.note: Description only — no build narrative found anywhere in memory.

items.name: tarboro-admin
items.desc: Teleport/goto/bring/coords, custom map blips, gathering-node move/delete, drug debug-give, injury commands (orphaned — see tarboro-injuries).
items.note: Extended repeatedly across this whole project.
